result.document_summary: A September 3, 2024 Los Angeles City Council motion instructing the Housing Department to report on landlord use of algorithm-based rent-setting software and the feasibility of banning it.
result.notes: The document is only a motion requesting a report and feasibility study; it enacts no rule and proposes no ban text. It mentions San Francisco's July 2024 algorithmic rent-setting ban only as background, without quoting the ordinance or giving its citation, effective date or terms, so no rule can be extracted for San Francisco from this document either.
